), 0) AS usedAmount, a.amount, a.created_at AS createdAt, a.opened_at AS openedAt, a.benefit FROM account a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN sell_order so ON so.account_id = a.account_id AND so.status IN ('RECEIVED', 'EXECUTED') LEFT JOIN krw_exchange ke ON ke.order_id = so.order_id GROUP BY a.account_id, a.customer_id, c.name, a.account_no, a.status, a.limit_amount, a.amount, a.created_at, a.opened_at, a.benefit ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.account_id DESC

SELECT fp.ticker, fp.name AS productName, fp.market, fp.currency, SUM(id.current_qty) AS currentQty FROM inbound_detail id JOIN inbound i ON i.inbound_id = id.inbound_id JOIN foreign_product fp ON fp.foreign_product_id = id.foreign_product_id WHERE i.account_id = #{accountId} AND id.current_qty > 0 GROUP BY fp.foreign_product_id, fp.ticker, fp.name, fp.market, fp.currency ORDER BY fp.ticker

SELECT i.inbound_id AS inboundId, fp.ticker, fp.name AS productName, id.source_broker AS sourceBroker, id.qty, id.current_qty AS currentQty, id.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, id.recorded_at AS recordedAt FROM inbound i JOIN inbound_detail id ON id.inbound_id = i.inbound_id JOIN foreign_product fp ON fp.foreign_product_id = id.foreign_product_id WHERE i.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY id.recorded_at DESC, id.inbound_detail_id DESC

SELECT closure_request_id AS closureRequestId, status, requested_at AS requestedAt, processed_at AS processedAt, rejection_reason AS rejectionReason FROM account_closure_request WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY requested_at DESC, closure_request_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT withdrawal_id AS withdrawalId, requested_amount AS requestedAmount, destination_account_no AS destinationAccountNo, status, processed_at AS processedAt FROM withdrawal WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY processed_at DESC, withdrawal_id DESC
